caption: The drawing depicts an ornamental wrought iron structure, mainly colored in shades of brown, featuring layered semi-circular arches stacked from largest at the base to smallest at the top, forming a tiered, stepped outline. A vertical post runs up the center, crowned by a horizontal crossbar forming a Christian cross at the very top. The structure sits above a rectangular base made of the same brown iron, with vertical bars extending downward and additional scroll-like, spiral elements in the lower section for decorative detail. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a smaller inset line drawing, in black, presenting an elevation view of a gate or a fence, which includes the same tiered shape and cross feature at the top. The composition centers the main colored illustration prominently on an off-white background, with the inset rendering aligned to the top right. The artist’s name, Manuel G. Runyan, appears lightly inscribed at the lower right.
title: Cross
